correction_flags.name: add
correction_flags.description: Sum the data point and correction value. E.g. y=x+C, where x is the data point and C is the change factor.

correction_flags.name: LW_correction
correction_flags.description: Correction for long wave radiation where calibration values are incorrect.

correction_flags.name: scalar
correction_flags.description: Multiply the data point by a correction factor. E.g. y=Cx where x is the data point and C is the correction factor.

correction_flags.name: PA_correction
correction_flags.description: Correct air pressure with bias calculated from mean sea level pressure.

correction_flags.name: power
correction_flags.description: Raise data point to power of correction factor. E.g. y=x^C where x is the data point and C is the correction factor.

correction_flags.name: WD_correction
correction_flags.description: Correct wind direction where wind sensor installed backwards.

correction_flags.name: clip
correction_flags.description: Clip values above or below threshold to the threshold.

quality_control_flags.name: range
quality_control_flags.description: Data fell outside of legitimate min and max.

quality_control_flags.name: battery_voltage
quality_control_flags.description: The battery voltage was too low to power the sensor properly.

quality_control_flags.name: samples
quality_control_flags.description: Too few samples were taken by the logger from the sensor within the measuring period.

quality_control_flags.name: error_code
quality_control_flags.description: The data value is an error code.

quality_control_flags.name: NR01_temp
quality_control_flags.description: The NR01 sensor temperature was out of operating range, meaning data cannot be trusted.

quality_control_flags.name: HFP_removal
quality_control_flags.description: Data removed during heat flux plate calibration period.

quality_control_flags.name: snow_day_signal
quality_control_flags.description: Signal from snow depth sensor too low.

quality_control_flags.name: TDT_soil_temp
quality_control_flags.description: Soil temperature too low for TDT to operate correctly.

infill_flags.name: linear_interp
infill_flags.description: Linear interpolation used to infill gap.

infill_flags.name: alt_data
infill_flags.description: Alternative data used to infill gap.
